_notes: Named rares of the Abyssal Sands. One item per kill. Hand-authored in tools/build_abyssal_content.py; spread checked by its audit().

The First Down.name: First-Down Goad
The First Down.flavor_text: Still in the hand it was in. The hand came up with it.

The First Down.name: Harness-Scarred Breastplate
The First Down.flavor_text: Four years in a hole and the buckles still work.

The First Down.name: Drover's Last Wraps
The First Down.flavor_text: Whoever went down first went down holding the reins.

The First Down.name: Three-Year Pendant
The First Down.flavor_text: The date scratched inside is the season the shallow wells went.

Axleback.name: Axleback's Hauling Chain
Axleback.flavor_text: Dragged out of a pit with a cart still attached to the other end.

Axleback.name: Cartfall Hide Jerkin
Axleback.flavor_text: It went in with the caravan and it came out without it.

Axleback.name: Teamster's Scaled Boots
Axleback.flavor_text: The ground gave way under these and they are still walking on it.

Axleback.name: Spoil-Ring Circlet
Axleback.flavor_text: Everything a hole throws up ends up in a ring round it.

The Wide Sink Mother.name: Brood-Mother's Shearing Limb
The Wide Sink Mother.flavor_text: Articulated. It should not be, and it is.

The Wide Sink Mother.name: Hollowed Carapace Guard
The Wide Sink Mother.flavor_text: Shell plate off something that only came up because the floor went down.

The Wide Sink Mother.name: Sink-Mother's Veil
The Wide Sink Mother.flavor_text: There is a smell in the Wide Sink and this has it.

The Wide Sink Mother.name: Crawler-Scale Bracers
The Wide Sink Mother.flavor_text: Thin, curved, and sharper than they have any right to be.

Glasswall Warden.name: Annealed Wall-Shard
Glasswall Warden.flavor_text: Sand fused into glass where something very hot came up through it.

Glasswall Warden.name: Glasswall Plate
Glasswall Warden.flavor_text: One face of it is still glass and will not take a scratch.

Glasswall Warden.name: Fused-Face Leggings
Glasswall Warden.flavor_text: The south face of that hole is a mirror in the afternoon.

Glasswall Warden.name: Annealing Band
Glasswall Warden.flavor_text: Warm, hours after sundown, in a desert that goes cold.

The Thing in the Throat.name: Throat-Cold Rod
The Thing in the Throat.flavor_text: Cold in a hole that has never held water in living memory.

The Thing in the Throat.name: Remembered-Water Mantle
The Thing in the Throat.flavor_text: Damp. Nobody has worked out how.

The Thing in the Throat.name: Deep-Throat Scale Vest
The Thing in the Throat.flavor_text: Whatever is down there came from somewhere that still has water in it.

The Thing in the Throat.name: Undertow Treads
The Thing in the Throat.flavor_text: It pulls, and there is nothing to pull with.

Longcollapse.name: Longcollapse Sweeper
Longcollapse.flavor_text: Twenty-two tiles of ground went in one afternoon and this was under it.

Longcollapse.name: Nothing-Left-Standing Girdle
Longcollapse.flavor_text: The longest hole on the map and the newest.

Longcollapse.name: Collapse-Walker's Leggings
Longcollapse.flavor_text: You can walk the length of that one and never be more than a step from the edge.

Longcollapse.name: Fallen-Ground Charm
Longcollapse.flavor_text: Picked up off ground that was twenty feet higher four years ago.

Underlight.name: Underlight's Lantern-Staff
Underlight.flavor_text: Something is lit down there and it was not lit by anybody.

Underlight.name: Glow-Touched Robes
Underlight.flavor_text: Stand on that rim at night and you can read by it.

Underlight.name: Drawn-Downward Spaulders
Underlight.flavor_text: Everybody who looks in wants to go in. That is the part nobody says.

Underlight.name: Deep-Shine Gauntlets
Underlight.flavor_text: The light comes UP, which is the wrong direction for a hole.
